Hi Harsh, there are quite a few of us Indian-Israeli couples; so, welcome to our tribe ;)  
For starters, I'd recommend visiting the website of the האגודה הישראלית לזוגות בינלאומיים aic.org.il (Israeli Association for International Couples) if you haven't already, and look up the "Gradual Process" section. It has all the info you need at least as far as paperwork is concerned.  
The time to permanent residency/citizenship is much shorter for married couples but both pathways ultimately have the same endpoint. You can also start as an unmarried couple and switch along the way, after you are married. 
Timelines can vary significantly depending, initially, on the embassy/consulate in India , and eventually the Misrad Hapnim office in Israel that will handle your case over the years. 
Overall, the process can be cumbersome; and will require some patience and discipline in terms of managing your paperwork. But the vast majority of genuine couples are able to navigate the process successfully. And of course, this group is always here to help. 

We also have a Whatsapp group specifically for Indian-Israeli couples, if you would like to join.
